entry: Ran message-sanitize.mjs (filterModelVisibleSessionMessages), loop/steering.mjs (createSteeringDrain), provider-prefix-guard.mjs (prepareProviderPrefixGuard), manager/turn-interruption.mjs (finalizeTurnInterruptionSnapshot) and shared/task-notification-envelope.mjs on the test file's inputs. Did not run persistCompactedOutgoingAfterAskFailure (needs the store) nor a real turn.
exclusions: meta.transcript.messageId of a drained notification (msg_ + 32 hex, random per run), at that path only, is recorded as msg_<id>
object identity (assert.equal(snapshot[i], messages[i])) is recorded as identity flags: sameArray, sameElements; a Rust copy needs only equality
every other value is recorded whole, encoded at the moment it was returned

replay (lines 66, 96): meta.transcript.messageId of the turn's prompt row (msg_ + 32 hex, random, stamped by the core's turn start) is removed: the recording holds the test's literal prompt row without one

replay line 66: the recorder drains before the first request with no tool batch; the product drains at the request after a tool batch (send-phase.mjs:53, core mixdog-agent run.rs begin_iteration), so afterDrain is compared as the prompt row and the row that drain appends

replay line 66: meta.execution and meta.submissionIds of the drained row are removed: they come from the product's queued completion (its execution and queue id); the recorder's hand-built entry {mode, content} has neither

replay line 66: sentHistory and the literal assistant/tool rows of nextRequest are the recorder's own test literals (recorder lines 98-108), not product values: replayed as the property they assert (the next turn's request starts with every row the previous request sent; its answer and new prompt have the recorded role and content)

replay line 66: guardFirst, retained, shrunkRequest and shrunk are the state and verdicts of Node's in-memory provider prefix guard (provider-prefix-guard.mjs), which the core does not hold (the migration drops _providerPrefixGuardState, store-migration 11.4.1): the core's rows are append-only, so the shrink it guards against has no product path
replay line 96: responsePreserved and userTurnPreserved are read as the client sees them: the prompt row is still the conversation's first row, and rows besides the prompt and the restart line remain

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay: Lines 32, 50: the rows appended with thread/inheritedRows/append and read back with thread/modelMessages/list (mixdog-core-session session/message_sanitize_replay.rs). Line 96: a turn's rows committed by the run, the process gone mid-turn, the thread reopened over the same store and read with thread/modelMessages/list (same file). Line 66: turn/start on the run host's real agent loop, the completion through TaskNotifier::finished, the conversation read with thread/modelMessages/list at each provider request (mixdog-core run_host/session_message_sanitize_replay.rs).
